// diagnostic

E0141

`#SingleUse` value consumed on only one `if` branch (D-LIN1)

What

`#SingleUse` value consumed on only one `if` branch (D-LIN1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0141

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0141: tests/ui/single_use_branch.stderr.

Error [E0141]: `db` must be used exactly once, but one path through this `if` leaves it unused
  --> tests/ui/single_use_branch.jet:15:5
    |
 15 |     db :: acquire("db")
    |     ^^
 Why: a `#SingleUse` value has to be used on every path — here it is consumed on one branch but not the other, so the program could reach the end of its scope without doing its job
 Fix: use `db` exactly once on every branch: consume it in the missing arm, or move it out before the `if`
